name: litellm-key
description: See your LiteLLM virtual key inside Claude Code: budget, spend, limits, expiry, models and recent usage.

litellm_url.title: LiteLLM proxy URL
litellm_url.description: Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, the proxy Claude Code already talks to.

litellm_key.title: LiteLLM virtual key
litellm_key.description: Leave empty to use the key Claude Code already sends (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or the x-litellm-api-key custom header).

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the key is re-read from the proxy.

warn_percent.title: Budget warning (%)
warn_percent.description: Show a toast once the key has used this much of its budget (it also warns at 95% and 100%).

show_status_line.title: Status line
show_status_line.description: Pin a one-line budget summary under the prompt.

show_related.title: User and team budgets
show_related.description: Also read /user/info and /team/info, since those budgets can block requests too.

show_usage.title: Usage history
show_usage.description: Also read /user/daily/activity for the last 7 days of spend and tokens (beta endpoint).

compact_pane.title: Compact pane
compact_pane.description: In a terminal too narrow for the table, draw the pane above the prompt compact: one line per meter, the facts side by side, as short as it can be. Off keeps the roomier layout.
